A free thirty minute workflow assessment

Start with one record.

Tell us what leaves your office. We will map the work from the printer to the person who receives it.

What the assessment maps

Thirty minutes. One record. A written map.

On site, we follow one record from your printer to the person who receives it, and document:

  1. Your document volume and record types
  2. The chain of custody break points
  3. Archive retrievability
  4. Your first service or handover protocol
  5. The users to train
  6. The recommended configuration and covers

What happens next

You receive a written map of that workflow, the records that should use the system, the recommended configuration, the users to train and the implementation plan. There is no obligation and nothing to sign. You keep the written map whether or not anything follows.
